name: CalmSEO
tagline: Search Console data and SEO research for AI agents
description: CalmSEO is a hosted SEO MCP server. Google Search Console analytics tools are free and read-only. Credit-based tools provide Google and Bing SERPs, keyword volume and CPC, keyword ideas, ranked keywords, and page audits, with explicit credit confirmation. Connect through OAuth; no local installation or Google API credentials are needed.

install.notes: Sign in to CalmSEO with OAuth, then connect a Google account to use Search Console tools. Research tools require credits.
